Chapter 6944: I Have Plenty Of Time

Chapter 6944: I Have Plenty Of Time

Breaker Immortal had lived for a long time. He had fur growing on his body and his head was slightly square, looking particularly sturdy. His eyes were sunken, making his nose even more prominent like a small hill.

His eyes brimmed with a deep, green light. This often indicated vitality and it was indeed the case. However, upon closer inspection, they also contained endless savagery.

Not only did he look like an ape, but he also only had a tattered piece of animal hide covering his waist. It wasn’t meant to cover his private part since as a primordial immortal, he cared not for mortal sensibilities. It played the part of carrying items, not something meant for modesty.

Given his title, spectators expected him to wield a destructive, torrential aura. His actual appearance surprised many.

Some wondered whether these two were actually father and son, given their appearance differences.

“What is happening?” Apex and Heaven’s Equal Immortal also woke up.

Primordial immortals in Ancient rarely appeared. For example, Breaker spent most of his time in hibernation, destroying a firmament and letting it rebuild for another cycle.

This was a good thing for everyone given his destructive temperament. However, he seemed to be more active this time.

“It’s war.” Apex frowned. He and others didn’t wish to see utter destruction in Ancient.

Breaker Immortal, upon awakening, focused his green gaze on Treasure Immortal Realm. Just this alone could obliterate the whole realm.

It might not be able to kill the sturdy immortals. Nevertheless, it intimidated them.

“What is going on?” A dreadful voice echoed.

“Father, he declares the destruction of our branch.” Treasure Immortal Lord bowed respectfully at his father while pointing at Li Qiye.

In the immortal world, cultivation determined everything. Upon reaching the upper realms, mundane ties became meaningless.

For example, father and son could refer to each other as “dao brother”. They could also fight to the death due to having differing dao views.

However, Treasure followed the conventional style and maintained the relationship. Of course, this was due to his father’s overwhelming strength and ruthlessness. It was best to keep him happy.

“Destroy my branch?” Breaker focused his gaze on Li Qiye alone. Of course, he paused for a moment to see a mortal.

“Sir, is there a feud between us?” He noticed something was extremely wrong.

“No, but it’s too bothersome to explain.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Do speak, I have plenty of time to know the reason behind your intent.” Breaker said.

Everyone was surprised to see such patience from Breaker. This didn’t match his ruthless reputation.
